column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 02 (M24002): inventarisasi kerusakan The Elmo, sumber kebocoran
# koordinat, lalu regu serbu OTs-14 dikirim melumpuhkan Jupiter Cannon.
# Tetap Inggris: Commander, The Elmo, Asteria, Dandelion, Mayling, Colphne, Nemesis,
# Krolik, Klukai, Squad 404, Voymastina, Ateraxis, Groza, Zucchero Squad, Melanie,
# Helena, Helen, OTs-14, Sextans, Mangi Security, Griffin, Jupiter Cannon, Railgun,
# Barracuda, Defy, Nirvana, Chiloveig, Boojum, Doll, Frame, neural cloud, Yellow Zone.
(Supported by Asteria, I arrived at the command room of The Elmo.)
column2: (Dengan Asteria menopangku, aku sampai di ruang komando The Elmo.)

column1: (Although Dandelion's previous warning had mentally prepared me, seeing The Elmo in such a mess, with its entire stern almost burned through, still broke through my psychological defenses.)
column2: (Meski peringatan Dandelion tadi sudah menyiapkanku secara mental, melihat The Elmo sekacau ini, dengan seluruh bagian buritan hampir terbakar tembus, tetap menjebol pertahanan batinku.)

column1: (This is absolutely not damage that ordinary weapons could inflict on The Elmo.)
column2: (Ini jelas bukan kerusakan yang bisa ditimbulkan senjata biasa pada The Elmo.)

column1: (The wreckage of many Doll frames is scattered across the floor, some of which I can't even identify who they belong to.)
column2: (Bangkai banyak frame Doll berserakan di lantai, sebagian bahkan tidak bisa kukenali milik siapa.)

column1: Thank goodness, you're awake...
column2: Syukurlah, kau sadar...

column1: (Mayling struggles to get up, staggering as she tries to throw herself at me.)
column2: (Mayling berusaha bangkit susah payah, terhuyung sambil mencoba menghambur ke arahku.)

column1: Mayling... *cough*, d-don't move around...
column2: Mayling... *uhuk*, j-jangan banyak bergerak...

column1: I finally managed to stop the bleeding!
column2: Aku baru berhasil menghentikan pendarahannya!

column1: (Beside Mayling, Colphne, whose frame was almost half severely burned, held her down.)
column2: (Di samping Mayling, Colphne yang frame-nya hampir separuh terbakar parah menahannya.)

column1: Commander... I'm sorry...
column2: Commander... maafkan aku...

column1: I didn't protect Mayling well, and let her get hurt so badly...
column2: Aku tidak melindungi Mayling dengan baik, dan membiarkannya terluka seberat itu...

column1: Don't say that, Colphne...
column2: Jangan bicara begitu, Colphne...

column1: You protected me, but you yourself...
column2: Kau melindungiku, tapi kau sendiri...

column1: I'm a Doll, so it doesn't matter...
column2: Aku ini Doll, jadi tidak masalah...

column1: Even if I'm blown to ashes by a cannon, my backup data can, can still be restored.
column2: Meski aku dihancurkan meriam sampai jadi abu, data backup-ku masih, masih bisa dipulihkan.

column1: That's not true...!
column2: Itu tidak benar...!

column1: Everyone was clearly so happily together, our... The Elmo.
column2: Kita semua jelas bahagia berkumpul bersama, The Elmo... milik kita.

column1: (I really wanted to gently hug Mayling and comfort her.)
column2: (Aku benar-benar ingin memeluk Mayling dengan lembut dan menghiburnya.)

column1: (But in reality, I just held her shoulders and looked into her eyes. A look of determination appeared in Mayling's red, teary eyes; she pursed her lips, holding back her tears.)
column2: (Tapi kenyataannya aku hanya memegang kedua bahunya dan menatap matanya. Segaris tekad muncul di mata Mayling yang merah dan berair; dia mengatupkan bibirnya, menahan tangis.)

column1: What is the situation with The Elmo now?
column2: Bagaimana kondisi The Elmo sekarang?

column1: What about everyone? Are the Dolls hurt?
column2: Bagaimana dengan semuanya? Ada Doll yang terluka?

column1: I just took inventory of the damage on The Elmo...
column2: Aku baru mendata kerusakan di The Elmo...

column1: The port side unit in the power system is the most severely damaged, causing the overall output power to drop to 23%... The main propulsion shaft has also severely shifted. So until the backup engine starts, The Elmo has lost its entire power system.
column2: Unit sisi kiri di sistem tenaga paling parah rusaknya, membuat daya keluaran total turun ke 23%... Poros pendorong utama juga bergeser parah. Jadi sampai mesin cadangan menyala, The Elmo kehilangan seluruh sistem tenaganya.

column1: Additionally, power distribution cabins 6, 7, and 8 at the rear were directly hit and can only barely be maintained through backup lines... The voltage fluctuation on the base vehicle has exceeded the threshold, and all precision electronic equipment could crash at any time...
column2: Selain itu, bilik distribusi daya 6, 7, dan 8 di bagian belakang kena hantaman langsung dan hanya bisa dipertahankan lewat jalur cadangan... Fluktuasi tegangan di kendaraan induk sudah melewati ambang batas, dan semua perangkat elektronik presisi bisa mati kapan saja...

column1: A-And... the defense system and communication system...
column2: D-dan... sistem pertahanan dan sistem komunikasinya...

column1: Looks like repairs are going to cost a fortune later.
column2: Kelihatannya perbaikannya nanti akan menelan biaya besar.

column1: It's fine, I'll gladly allocate the funds.
column2: Tidak masalah, aku dengan senang hati mengalokasikan dananya.

column1: (Listening to Mayling's increasingly quiet voice, I could only try to joke around to cheer her up.)
column2: (Mendengar suara Mayling yang makin lirih, aku hanya bisa mencoba melempar gurauan untuk menyemangatinya.)

column1: Although everyone's neural clouds are fine, the storage points for armaments and frames have suffered severe losses...
column2: Meski neural cloud semuanya aman, titik penyimpanan persenjataan dan frame mengalami kerugian berat...

column1: Nemesis's frame overloaded and she still hasn't woken up. So far, we've only had time to complete the reboot for Krolik and a few others.
column2: Frame Nemesis kelebihan beban dan dia masih belum sadar. Sampai sekarang kami baru sempat menyelesaikan reboot untuk Krolik dan beberapa lainnya.

column1: To send you back to the Elmo, Klukai and the rest of Squad 404's frames were also basically completely destroyed... And Voymastina, she was... by Ateraxis...
column2: Demi mengirimmu kembali ke Elmo, frame Klukai dan anggota Squad 404 lainnya juga hampir hancur total... Dan Voymastina, dia... oleh Ateraxis...

column1: Captain Groza and the others, even though their frames were still severely damaged, didn't have the luxury of repairs and immediately went to execute the operation.
column2: Captain Groza dan yang lain, meski frame mereka masih rusak berat, tidak punya kemewahan untuk diperbaiki dan langsung pergi menjalankan operasi.

column1: Where did Groza and the others go?
column2: Ke mana Groza dan yang lain pergi?

column1: The Captain and the others, the members of Zucchero Squad, and everyone who woke up... as soon as they recovered, they tried to find a way to stop the enemies outside.
column2: Captain dan yang lain, anggota Zucchero Squad, dan semua yang sudah sadar... begitu pulih, mereka langsung mencari cara menghentikan musuh di luar.

column1: As for the others, I... I haven't had time to check on everyone's condition yet...
column2: Soal yang lainnya, aku... aku belum sempat memeriksa kondisi semua orang...

column1: Commander, as a mechanic, I've really failed in my duties...
column2: Commander, sebagai mekanik, aku benar-benar gagal menjalankan tugasku...

column1: (Looking at Mayling's disheartened appearance, I know that I absolutely cannot show any weakness right now.)
column2: (Melihat Mayling yang begitu patah semangat, aku tahu sekarang aku sama sekali tidak boleh menunjukkan kelemahan.)

column1: (Even if The Elmo is destroyed, even if we face the siege of countless enemies, at a time like this, the only thing we can do is stay calm.)
column2: (Meski The Elmo hancur, meski kami dikepung musuh yang tak terhitung, di saat seperti ini satu-satunya yang bisa kami lakukan adalah tetap tenang.)

column1: (I absolutely cannot break down either.)
column2: (Aku juga sama sekali tidak boleh runtuh.)

column1: No... Mayling, this isn't your fault.
column2: Tidak... Mayling, ini bukan salahmu.

column1: If you weren't here, The Elmo would likely have been completely destroyed... Although the current damage is severe, we can still continue to fight.
column2: Kalau kau tidak ada di sini, The Elmo kemungkinan sudah hancur total... Meski kerusakannya sekarang berat, kita masih bisa terus bertarung.

column1: So, you've already done very well.
column2: Jadi, kau sudah melakukannya dengan sangat baik.

column1: It's just that next, we have to face even more severe challenges. No matter how much strength we have left, we must use it effectively.
column2: Hanya saja setelah ini kita harus menghadapi tantangan yang lebih berat. Sebanyak apa pun kekuatan yang tersisa, harus kita pakai secara efektif.

column1: In the enemy's eyes, we should have already lost the ability to resist—but as long as it exceeds the scheduled operation time, they might use this highly destructive weapon again.
column2: Di mata musuh, kita seharusnya sudah kehilangan kemampuan melawan—tapi begitu melewati jadwal operasi mereka, senjata berdaya rusak tinggi itu bisa dipakai lagi.

column1: We must race against time to deal with it.
column2: Kita harus berlomba dengan waktu untuk mengatasinya.

column1: (Mentioning the enemy suddenly reminds me of something.)
column2: (Menyinggung soal musuh tiba-tiba mengingatkanku pada sesuatu.)

column1: Right... Mayling, I have something I need to confirm with you.
column2: Benar... Mayling, ada yang perlu kupastikan padamu.

column1: Yes... please go ahead.
column2: Ya... silakan.

column1: When The Elmo was hit, were its coordinates still inside the collapse storm?
column2: Saat The Elmo dihantam, apa koordinatnya masih di dalam badai collapse?

column1: Yes, I've confirmed it... Even if the enemy deployed military-grade detection equipment, it would be impossible to detect the Elmo's real-time coordinates so accurately from inside the collapse storm.
column2: Iya, sudah kupastikan... Meski musuh mengerahkan perangkat deteksi kelas militer, mustahil mereka bisa membaca koordinat Elmo secara real-time seakurat itu dari dalam badai collapse.

column1: Is there any other possibility of the coordinates being leaked?
column2: Ada kemungkinan lain koordinatnya bocor?

column1: Absolutely not... The Elmo being inside the collapse storm means that neither reconnaissance from the outside in, nor signals sent from the inside out, could possibly penetrate the interference of the collapse storm.
column2: Sama sekali tidak... The Elmo berada di dalam badai collapse berarti pengintaian dari luar ke dalam, maupun sinyal yang dikirim dari dalam ke luar, mustahil menembus gangguan badai itu.

column1: So I don't understand why, even though we were hiding inside the collapse storm, we still...
column2: Jadi aku tidak paham kenapa, meski kita bersembunyi di dalam badai collapse, kita tetap...

column1: Did anything happen before the Elmo was bombarded?
column2: Apa ada kejadian sebelum Elmo dibombardir?

column1: We encountered that third-generation Doll named "Ateraxis" you mentioned before. Wuuwaa, does she even count as a Doll... Anyway, the Captain and everyone worked together and temporarily repelled her.
column2: Kami berhadapan dengan Doll generasi ketiga bernama "Ateraxis" yang kau sebut tadi. Huwaa, apa dia masih terhitung Doll... Pokoknya Captain dan semuanya bekerja sama dan sementara berhasil memukulnya mundur.

column1: 难道是……
column2: Jangan-jangan...

column1: (Thinking of the series of events that happened before, I suddenly have some kind of ominous premonition.)
column2: (Mengingat rangkaian kejadian sebelumnya, aku tiba-tiba merasakan semacam pertanda buruk.)

column1: (Asteria just said that Ateraxis and Chiloveig getting involved together is very likely for the purpose of reopening Nirvana.)
column2: (Asteria baru saja bilang Ateraxis dan Chiloveig bersatu sangat mungkin bertujuan membuka kembali Nirvana.)

column1: (And the Barracuda node was only recently transferred to the Elmo... I believe in Defy's abilities, they must have done it completely unnoticed.)
column2: (Dan node Barracuda baru saja dipindahkan ke Elmo... aku percaya pada kemampuan Defy, mereka pasti melakukannya tanpa terdeteksi sama sekali.)

column1: (But Ateraxis still managed to lock onto the tiny Elmo in the endless Yellow Zone...)
column2: (Tapi Ateraxis tetap berhasil mengunci Elmo yang begitu kecil di Yellow Zone yang tak berujung...)

column1: The thing that leaked the Elmo's coordinates was indeed that...
column2: Yang membocorkan koordinat Elmo memang benda itu...

column1: (The Barracuda node.)
column2: (Node Barracuda.)

column1: Mayling, can the radar and communication systems still be activated?
column2: Mayling, sistem radar dan komunikasi masih bisa diaktifkan?

column1: The Elmo is heavily damaged, only some functions can be maintained...
column2: The Elmo rusak berat, hanya sebagian fungsi yang bisa dipertahankan...

column1: The communication system is completely broken due to the energy impact and collapse storm, and there's no way to fix it for now...
column2: Sistem komunikasinya rusak total karena hantaman energi dan badai collapse, dan sekarang tidak ada cara memperbaikinya...

column1: Alright, I understand.
column2: Baik, aku paham.

column1: Dandelion, coordinate with Mayling to take inventory of the current battle damage. Under the premise of preserving neural cloud data, find usable Frames as soon as possible to restore the combat power on The Elmo.
column2: Dandelion, koordinasi dengan Mayling untuk mendata kerusakan tempur sekarang. Dengan syarat data neural cloud tetap terjaga, cari Frame yang bisa dipakai secepat mungkin untuk memulihkan kekuatan tempur The Elmo.

column1: Leave this kind of thing to me~
column2: Urusan seperti itu serahkan padaku~

column1: Compared to when I was slowly crawling data remotely with a small pipe, I can do much more now.
column2: Dibanding waktu aku merayapi data dari jauh lewat pipa kecil, sekarang aku bisa melakukan jauh lebih banyak.

column1: Asteria, please act as my temporary adjutant for now... The communication system is damaged, and the command console is probably unusable too. So, I hope you can take charge of restoring contact with the personnel fighting outside.
column2: Asteria, tolong jadi adjutant sementaraku dulu... Sistem komunikasinya rusak, dan konsol komando kemungkinan juga tidak bisa dipakai. Jadi kuharap kau bisa memegang urusan memulihkan kontak dengan personel yang bertarung di luar.

column1: Yes. I will try to search for everyone's signals and re-establish the comms channel.
column2: Baik. Aku akan mencoba mencari sinyal semua orang dan membangun ulang saluran komunikasinya.

column1: Also...
column2: Dan juga...

column1: Melanie? And... Helena?!
column2: Melanie? Dan... Helena?!

column1: (Seeing two small figures rushing towards me, my tense mood finally relaxed a little.)
column2: (Melihat dua figur kecil berlari ke arahku, hatiku yang tegang akhirnya melonggar sedikit.)

column1: (I hold them in my arms and gently stroke their heads.)
column2: (Aku memeluk mereka dan mengusap lembut kepala keduanya.)

column1: Thank goodness, as long as you're okay...
column2: Syukurlah, selama kalian baik-baik saja...

column1: Commander—it's, it's them—
column2: Commander—ini, ini mereka—

column1: They're the ones who saved Helena, and Melanie too!
column2: Mereka yang menyelamatkan Helena, dan Melanie juga!

column1: (I look up and see OTs-14 and Sextans standing not far behind them.)
column2: (Aku mengangkat kepala dan melihat OTs-14 serta Sextans berdiri tidak jauh di belakang mereka.)

column1: (They were also covered in scars, seemingly having spent a lot of effort to crawl out of the bombed ruins.)
column2: (Keduanya juga penuh luka, sepertinya butuh usaha besar untuk merangkak keluar dari puing yang dibom.)

column1: Thank you...
column2: Terima kasih...

column1: 没、没什么。
column2: B-bukan apa-apa.

column1: We... just happened to be there.
column2: Kami... cuma kebetulan ada di sana.

column1: Are you alright?
column2: Kau baik-baik saja?

column1: Please let me examine you immediately...
column2: Izinkan aku segera memeriksamu...

column1: I'm fine... don't worry.
column2: Aku tidak apa-apa... jangan khawatir.

column1: Speaking of which, what exactly was that bombardment just now...
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, sebenarnya apa bombardir tadi...

column1: Within the scope of my knowledge, neither the financial conglomerates nor Mangi Security... possess weapons with this kind of lethality.
column2: Sebatas pengetahuanku, konglomerat finansial maupun Mangi Security... tidak punya senjata dengan daya bunuh seperti itu.

column1: Looking at it this way, it could only be a weapon of mass destruction from the military.
column2: Kalau begitu, itu hanya bisa senjata pemusnah massal milik militer.

column1: The military, huh...
column2: Militer, ya...

column1: 对了，难道是——！
column2: Benar juga, jangan-jangan——!

column1: Did you think of something?
column2: Kau teringat sesuatu?

column1: Hmm... I did think of one thing...
column2: Hmm... aku memang teringat satu hal...

column1: And... Commander, you should also be quite familiar with this kind of weapon.
column2: Dan... Commander, kau seharusnya juga cukup akrab dengan senjata semacam itu.

column1: (After OTs-14's reminder, the guess in my heart suddenly becomes clear.)
column2: (Setelah diingatkan OTs-14, dugaan di hatiku tiba-tiba menjadi jelas.)

column1: (After all, back in Griffin, I had commanded Doll squads to dismantle it more than once.)
column2: (Lagi pula, dulu di Griffin aku pernah lebih dari sekali mengomando regu Doll untuk melumpuhkannya.)

column1: Railgun... also known as the Jupiter Cannon.
column2: Railgun... yang juga dikenal sebagai Jupiter Cannon.

column1: To deal with The Elmo, they actually resorted to such methods...
column2: Untuk mengurus The Elmo, mereka sampai memakai cara seperti itu...

column1: How long has it been since the last attack?
column2: Sudah berapa lama sejak serangan terakhir?

column1: About half an hour.
column2: Sekitar setengah jam.

column1: We don't have much time left.
column2: Waktu kita tidak banyak.

column1: The enemy has military-grade weapons on the level of a Jupiter Cannon, and it will finish charging soon. If we can't prepare before the next attack, the Elmo and everyone on board will suffer severe damage.
column2: Musuh punya senjata kelas militer setingkat Jupiter Cannon, dan pengisian dayanya akan selesai segera. Kalau kita tidak siap sebelum serangan berikutnya, Elmo dan semua orang di dalamnya akan menderita kerusakan berat.

column1: Although the Elmo has lost most of its mobility, and it would be more efficient for the enemy to attack with conventional forces and weapons...
column2: Meski Elmo sudah kehilangan sebagian besar mobilitasnya, dan lebih efisien bagi musuh untuk menyerang dengan pasukan dan senjata konvensional...

column1: But in case they have other motives, I absolutely don't want to risk the Elmo and everyone on board.
column2: Tapi kalau-kalau mereka punya motif lain, aku sama sekali tidak mau mempertaruhkan Elmo dan semua orang di dalamnya.

column1: We need to quickly find a way to start the Elmo's backup engine.
column2: Kita harus cepat mencari cara menyalakan mesin cadangan Elmo.

column1: Commander, as long as this Jupiter Cannon is here, you and the Elmo will constantly be under its threat.
column2: Commander, selama Jupiter Cannon itu masih ada, kau dan Elmo akan terus berada di bawah ancamannya.

column1: When the time comes, not only will the Elmo's retreat route be restricted, but there's also what we couldn't figure out just now... the matter of the Elmo's coordinates being leaked...
column2: Nanti bukan cuma rute mundur Elmo yang terkunci, tapi juga hal yang belum kita pecahkan tadi... soal koordinat Elmo yang bocor...

column1: So I want to help too.
column2: Jadi aku ingin ikut membantu.

column1: Help? But...
column2: Membantu? Tapi...

column1: I still remember the method you commanded us to use to dismantle the Jupiter Cannon back in Griffin.
column2: Aku masih ingat cara yang kau perintahkan kepada kami untuk melumpuhkan Jupiter Cannon dulu di Griffin.

column1: As long as the surrounding power supply facilities are destroyed, the Jupiter Cannon will no longer be able to gather enough energy.
column2: Selama fasilitas pemasok daya di sekitarnya dihancurkan, Jupiter Cannon tidak akan bisa lagi mengumpulkan energi yang cukup.

column1: When that time comes, such a giant weapon will only become a burden to the military.
column2: Saat itu terjadi, senjata sebesar itu hanya akan jadi beban bagi militer.

column1: Even if the theory is clear, it's still too much for you to handle alone...
column2: Meski teorinya jelas, itu tetap terlalu berat kau tangani sendiri...

column1: And me.
column2: Ada aku juga.

column1: With our combined combat strength, it should be enough to deal with the enemies we encounter along the way.
column2: Dengan kekuatan tempur kami berdua digabung, seharusnya cukup untuk mengurus musuh yang kami jumpai di jalan.

column1: Commander, I'm going too.
column2: Commander, aku ikut juga.

column1: (Helen was covered in scars, but still held her weapon and requested to join the battle.)
column2: (Helen penuh luka, tapi tetap menggenggam senjatanya dan meminta ikut bertempur.)

column1: Now that Dandelion is on The Elmo, I hope to provide electronic warfare support.
column2: Karena Dandelion ada di The Elmo, aku ingin memberi dukungan perang elektronik.

column1: Your Frame...
column2: Frame-mu...

column1: It's okay, Commander. Fighting for you is our happiness, you don't need to consider these unnecessary things.
column2: Tidak masalah, Commander. Bertarung untukmu adalah kebahagiaan kami, kau tidak perlu memikirkan hal-hal yang tidak perlu itu.

column1: Your Excellency, now is not the time to hesitate.
column2: Tuan, sekarang bukan waktunya ragu.

column1: Please give us your orders as soon as possible.
column2: Tolong beri kami perintah secepatnya.

column1: (A multitude of tangled thoughts churned in my mind.)
column2: (Berbagai pikiran yang kusut berputar di kepalaku.)

column1: (From the sudden joint military operation by the conglomerate and the military, to the deployment of the Jupiter Cannon to bombard The Elmo... and Ateraxis's actions. Although the other side used every trick in the book, it didn't seem like they were working together.)
column2: (Dari operasi militer gabungan konglomerat dan militer yang tiba-tiba, sampai pengerahan Jupiter Cannon untuk membombardir The Elmo... dan gerakan Ateraxis. Meski pihak sana memakai segala cara, sepertinya mereka tidak bekerja sama.)

column1: (Just as Asteria said, the enemies are not only the ones I can see.)
column2: (Seperti kata Asteria, musuhnya bukan cuma yang bisa kulihat.)

column1: (After losing so many things, all I can do right now is try my best to preserve what we still have.)
column2: (Setelah kehilangan begitu banyak hal, yang bisa kulakukan sekarang hanyalah berusaha sekuat tenaga menjaga apa yang masih kami punya.)

column1: (The Elmo stores all the Dolls' neural cloud backups, which I absolutely must protect. And Helena, Melanie, and the 'Barracuda' must never fall into their hands, so we cannot abandon the Elmo right now.)
column2: (The Elmo menyimpan seluruh backup neural cloud para Doll, dan itu mutlak harus kulindungi. Dan Helena, Melanie, serta 'Barracuda' tidak boleh jatuh ke tangan mereka, jadi kami tidak bisa meninggalkan Elmo sekarang.)

column1: (Just as OTs-14 said, the Jupiter Cannon is the weapon that poses a direct threat to the Elmo right now—and time is of the essence.)
column2: (Seperti kata OTs-14, Jupiter Cannon adalah senjata yang mengancam Elmo secara langsung sekarang—dan waktunya sangat mendesak.)

column1: Combat plan accepted. Dandelion, what are the bearing and distance of the trajectory?
column2: Rencana tempur diterima. Dandelion, berapa arah dan jarak lintasannya?

column1: Trajectory reverse-engineering complete.
column2: Rekonstruksi balik lintasannya selesai.

column1: At the moment of the attack, an extremely high energy peak appeared in that direction—the position of the 'Jupiter Cannon' has been locked on.
column2: Saat serangan itu terjadi, muncul puncak energi yang sangat tinggi dari arah sana—posisi 'Jupiter Cannon' sudah terkunci.

column1: But that area was scanned by beacons within the last few dozen hours, and no facilities were found at the time. Therefore, the enemy's Jupiter Cannon is obviously mobile.
column2: Tapi area itu sudah dipindai beacon dalam beberapa puluh jam terakhir, dan waktu itu tidak ada fasilitas yang ditemukan. Jadi Jupiter Cannon musuh jelas bisa berpindah.

column1: ...We must take out its power supply facilities immediately. How much time do we have left?
column2: ...Kita harus segera menghabisi fasilitas pemasok dayanya. Berapa waktu yang tersisa?

column1: An orbital weapon of this scale requires time to recharge and reset, but given its current charging efficiency, the time until the next shot will be shorter than you think.
column2: Senjata orbital sebesar itu butuh waktu untuk mengisi ulang dan reset, tapi dengan efisiensi pengisiannya sekarang, waktu sampai tembakan berikutnya akan lebih singkat dari yang kau bayangkan.

column1: Understood.
column2: Dimengerti.

column1: (Since this was a hastily decided raid plan, and the target was an important enemy facility base, I assembled the most complete and highly mobile team that could be deployed under the current circumstances.)
column2: (Karena ini rencana serangan yang diputuskan mendadak, dan sasarannya pangkalan fasilitas penting musuh, aku menyusun tim paling lengkap dan bermobilitas tinggi yang bisa dikerahkan dalam keadaan sekarang.)

column1: (I look at the several Dolls assembled before me, my gaze finally landing on OTs-14.)
column2: (Aku menatap beberapa Doll yang berkumpul di depanku, dan tatapanku akhirnya jatuh pada OTs-14.)

column1: (She is covered in wounds from the previous battle with Ateraxis, and the Boojum cells in her body seem to have been heavily depleted as well.)
column2: (Dia penuh luka dari pertempuran sebelumnya dengan Ateraxis, dan sel Boojum di tubuhnya sepertinya juga terkuras berat.)

column1: With your level of damage, you really should stay behind on The Elmo. But if we let the enemy keep shooting, The Elmo is finished. This operation cannot fail.
column2: Dengan tingkat kerusakanmu, kau seharusnya tetap tinggal di The Elmo. Tapi kalau musuh dibiarkan terus menembak, The Elmo habis. Operasi ini tidak boleh gagal.

column1: The Commander's and my The Elmo, of course we can't lose it here.
column2: The Elmo milikku dan Commander, tentu tidak boleh kita kehilangannya di sini.

column1: I'll go too.
column2: Aku ikut juga.

column1: (Although Krolik had just finished rebooting not long ago, she had already participated in the battle to defend the perimeter of the Elmo at the first opportunity.)
column2: (Meski Krolik baru selesai reboot, dia sudah ikut bertempur mempertahankan perimeter Elmo pada kesempatan pertama.)

column1: (At this moment, she casually tossed aside the temporary weapon in her hand, which already had a somewhat chipped edge, and neatly swapped to new equipment.)
column2: (Saat itu dia sekenanya melempar senjata sementara di tangannya yang matanya sudah agak tumpul, lalu bertukar rapi ke perlengkapan baru.)

column1: ...Krolik, The Elmo also needs defensive forces right now.
column2: ...Krolik, The Elmo juga butuh kekuatan pertahanan sekarang.

column1: (Krolik didn't look at OTs-14, but looked straight at me.)
column2: (Krolik tidak menoleh ke OTs-14, tapi menatap langsung ke arahku.)

column1: Commander, the perimeter of The Elmo is temporarily safe.
column2: Commander, perimeter The Elmo sementara aman.

column1: But raiding such a heavily guarded position will definitely end up in close-quarters combat.
column2: Tapi menyerbu posisi yang dijaga seketat itu pasti berakhir dengan pertempuran jarak dekat.

column1: That guy Nemesis hasn't woken up yet. If I don't perform a bit more for her share too, she'll laugh at me later.
column2: Nemesis itu belum sadar. Kalau aku tidak tampil sedikit lebih banyak untuk bagiannya juga, nanti dia menertawakanku.

column1: I understand, but you must obey OTs-14's commands.
column2: Aku paham, tapi kau harus menuruti komando OTs-14.

column1: Understood... Captain.
column2: Dimengerti... Captain.

column1: ...Krolik, thank you.
column2: ...Krolik, terima kasih.

column1: Alright... OTs-14, you will be the captain of this assault squad.
column2: Baik... OTs-14, kau jadi kapten regu serbu ini.

column1: I will arrange for drones to assist you in covertly reaching the coordinates of the enemy's weapon.
column2: Aku akan mengatur drone untuk membantu kalian mencapai koordinat senjata musuh secara diam-diam.

column1: Your objective is: destroy the Jupiter Cannon's core energy relay station. As long as you cut off any main power supply line, you can force the main cannon into a mandatory cooldown.
column2: Objektif kalian: hancurkan stasiun relai energi inti Jupiter Cannon. Selama satu saja jalur pasokan daya utamanya terputus, meriam utamanya bisa dipaksa masuk pendinginan wajib.

column1: Yes, Commander.
column2: Baik, Commander.

column1: ...I'm leaving everything to you.
column2: ...Aku menyerahkan semuanya pada kalian.
